 There is still time to secure your place at Infrastructure Finance Forum: Asia 2026
 

 Don’t miss your chance to join Infrastructure Finance Forum: Asia 2026 

on 10 & 11 November in Singapore - the premier event bringing together the brightest minds in infrastructure finance across APAC.

 

Get ready for an engaging two-day agenda tackling the key opportunities and challenges shaping the industry. From the energy transition to offshore wind, you’ll gain critical insights from top experts and industry leaders.

 

Networking has already started! All attendees will have access to our dedicated event networking app, making it easy to discover fellow participants, connect with industry peers and start building valuable relationships ahead of the event.

Register Now

Green Street Infrastructure subscribers have access to an exclusive 20% discount on delegate tickets. Simply enter the code Subs20%IFFAsia26
at checkout to secure your subscriber rate.

20% discount available on the standard ticket rate only.
Agenda Highlights Include:

Day 1

  • Is this Asia’s Infrastructure “Moment”? 

  • How Welcome are Innovative Capital Structures in Asia
  • Datacenters: Can Unsatiable Demand Overcome Familiar Constraints? 

Day 2

  •  Power, Data and Trust: Datacenters and the Social License to Operate 

  •  India: Where Scalable Capital and Structural Bottlenecks Collide 
  •  No Grid, No Transition: Breaking Through the Trillion Dollar Bottleneck?
2026 Attendees Include:

Don't miss the opportunity to connect with leading project sponsors, developers, fund managers and capital providers at Infrastructure Finance Forum: Asia 2026. Exchange insights, strengthen industry relationships and engage with the decision-makers driving infrastructure investment across the region.
